tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run a TypeScript/JavaScript snippet that calls your tools as async functions inside an isolated sandbox (no network, files, imports or Node APIs). Write the body of an async function and `return` the result. Call tools as `await <server>.<tool>(input)`, for example `await github.list_pull_requests({ owner, repo, state: 'open' })`; allowed built-in tools are under `builtin` (e.g. `builtin.view`). Results are parsed JSON when possible; failed or denied calls throw. Use Promise.all for independent calls, filter and aggregate in code, and return only what the answer needs: do all counting, summing, sorting and ranking inside the code and return the final numbers rather than adding up rows yourself. Results over ~6K tokens are truncated (the full value stays in `$last`). `state` is an object that persists between runs. Call search_functions first for exact signatures and return shapes. Use this when a task needs 3+ tool calls, loops over results, or pulls bulk data you only need part of. For a single small lookup, call the tool directly.

code.description: Body of an async function. Use `return` for the result.

tools.name: search_functions
tools.description: Find functions callable from run_code. Returns TypeScript signatures with parameter docs and, once learned, the shape of what each returns. Query by intent, e.g. "list pull requests" or "review comments".
